successors.statement: Reachable transformation cost set is the image of admitted M->N processes under the declared cost account; unreachable pairs have empty cost set.
Pareto/frontier views are conditional on existence of undominated elements; arbitrary infinite cost sets need not have minima.
With zero-cost identity, nonnegative scalarization and subadditive composition, finite scalar burden has identity-zero and triangle behavior; symmetry is not required.
A bijective path/process presentation transport that preserves cost transports the reachable cost set exactly.
On the registered finite cost set, response/reachability/cost-preserving relabeling preserves the Pareto front; a cost-changing control does not.
